channel.title: Origin of Speech
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Origin of Speech

item.description: मनोरौ वा 4.1.37 - 4.1.39 SV: मनोः औ वा AV: उदात्तः ए Language Meaning: In forming the feminine with the affix ङीप् , औ is optionally the substitute of the final मनु (as well as the उदात्त ऐ).
पूतक्रतोरै च 4.1.35 - 4.1.37 SV: none AV: none Language Meaning: In forming the feminine, the letter ऐ is the substitute of the final word पूतक्तु when the affix ङीप् is added.

वृषाकप्यग्निकुसितकुसिदानामुदात्तः 4.1.36 - 4.1.38 SV: वृषाकपि-अग्नि-कुसित-कुसिदानाम् उदात्तः AV: ऐ Language Meaning: In forming the feminine with the affix ङीप् the letter ऐ having उदात्त accent is the substitute of the finals १.

item.title: वृष्
item.description: वृषुँ = व ऋ ष उ चंद्र बिंदी wave superior droplets outside person superior droplets inside रूढ अर्थ शक्तिबन्धन = शक्ति + बन्धन = शक् + क्तिन् + बन्ध् + ल्युट् सेचन हिंसा = र in रिष is considered liquid सङ्क्लेशन = सङ् + क्लेश = स ङ क्लिश् + घञ्.

नित्यं सपत्न्यादिषु 4.1.34 - 4.1.36 SV: नित्यं सपत्नी-आदिषु AV: अनुपसर्जनात् पत्युः नः Language Meaning: In forming the feminine with the affix ङीप् the word पति always takes the substitute न् in the words like सपत्नि etc.

विभाषा सपूर्वस्य 4.1.33 - 4.1.35 SV: none AV: अनुपसर्जनात् पत्युः नः Language Meaning: In forming the feminine with the affix ङीप् , न् is optionally the substitute of the final इ of पति when the latter is preceded by another vowel Literal Meaning: व इ भ अ ष अ - स प उ र व स य wave inward ground till...

पत्युर्नो यज्ञसंयोगे 4.1.32 - 4.1.34 SV : पत्युः नः यज्ञ-संयोगे AV: अनुपसर्जनात् Language Meaning: The substitute न् replaces the final इ of पति before the feminine affix ङीप् when the word so formed means ‘a wife’ who takes part in the sacrifices of her husband.

item.title: पति
item.description: पति = पा + डति footing up to fearsome float object rope upto fear that inward rope up to large tumbi inward.

item.title: पूज्
item.description: पूजँ = प उ ज चंद्र बिंदी leg outward wide verb(footing) wide verb(rope) wide verb(oar) open/spread/widen verb(limb) jump रूढ अर्थ Self circular reference.
